name: hero-split
title: Split hero
author: Lambda Curry <https://github.com/lambda-curry>
description: Headline, lede and actions beside one framed image or artwork, stacking copy-first on narrow screens.

meta.useWhen: There is one strong, real image or artwork that shows the actual work, and a clear first action.
meta.avoidWhen: There is no genuine image. Use hero-typographic rather than a stock or decorative picture.

docs: Import from src/components/blocks/HeroSplit.astro. Pass image, or use the media slot for a picture, video or SVG.
